programs.title: Lakefront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.sub_title: Loving Life on Lake Tawakoni in Texas
programs.desc: Water enthusiasts Matt and Heather find a vacation property close to their Dallas home on Lake Tawakoni in Texas, and they plan to open up the kitchen, remodel the bathrooms, build a multi-level deck and fix up the boat dock.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Chase Morrill and his team help a homeowner renovate a lake house with children in mind; with a budget of $30,000, the crew members are going to have to use their imaginations to impress their young clients.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Ashley Morrill and her team of builders find themselves rebuilding an old oyster shack for a working oyster farm in Edgecomb, Maine; forced into immediate action, the team starts its preliminary work with snow still on the ground.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: With winter fast approaching, the team works feverishly to finish a play cabin for the Kennebec Valley YMCA in Augusta, Maine; also, Ryan decides it's time to build the workshop that Chase Morrill has always wanted.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Taking It to the Finish Line
programs.desc: Chase and the team are hired to finish a cabin for a homeowner who's been collecting materials for years but hasn't been able to finish the project; with a budget of $20,000, the crew hopes to make the homeowners' dream a reality in eight weeks.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Chase and the crew seek to turn a vacation cabin that was originally a 1920s horse barn into a stable building for a large family; drawing from the past, the crew wants to honor the owners' late parents in this emotional build.
